answeredQuestions.core-problem: Logging output interferes with Rich/Textual interactive UI causing visual artifacts
answeredQuestions.solution-approach: Configuration-based control of logging output per execution mode
answeredQuestions.target-users: End users (clean UI), Developers (debugging), DevOps (log analysis)
answeredQuestions.testing-approach: Hybrid - unit tests for config loading, manual verification for UI
answeredQuestions.constraints: Minimal code changes, no log loss, backwards compatible, configurable log path
answeredQuestions.scope-boundaries: In: mode-aware logging, file handler, CLI flag. Out: rotation, aggregation, JSON format, per-agent config
